title: Average electricity and water prices

period.label: Latest available per area (2014–2026); see areas.csv

nativeResolution: Country, or state/province for the US, Canada and Australia (electricity)
sampling: Each resolution-6 cell takes the price of the area containing its centre (coastal cells: the overlapping area). Zoomed-out hexagons show the mean.

aggregation.toRes6: area value repeated in every cell

averaging: Day/night (time-of-use) tariffs: hours-weighted average of the periods.
Tiered tariffs: effective price at a typical household use (~250 kWh, ~15 m³ per month), fixed charges included where known.
Seasonal tariffs: annual average. Official statistics (EIA, Eurostat) are revenue ÷ sales averages over all tariffs, so they already include these.
caveats: One average per country or state: real tariffs vary by utility, city, customer size and contract.
Water prices are mostly the capital or largest utility's tariff; some exclude wastewater (see basis).
Converted to USD at the World Bank annual average exchange rate; volatile currencies distort comparisons.
Sources differ in year and tax treatment; read each cell's basis line before comparing.
